cards.title: Sand Wurm: 30 fixes
cards.text: Same fight, its problems hunted down: 31 found by playing and filming it, 30 fixed. Live in 0.33.0.
cards.why: You said it was good but had many misc problems. Mark any part still off.

parts.title: Plainly broken
parts.text: Its body vanished whenever the head dived; the phase-turn roar showed no wurm at all; single rings had health bars; heroes wasted most blows on the sand mound. All fixed: the body stays drawn, it comes up to roar, no ring bars, and heroes hold their hits until it's up.

parts.title: Looks
parts.text: Drawn in the right order by height; sand rays along the floor instead of stakes over the wurm; one even status wash, not every ring see-through; a real bite with its own jaws; dust clouds and clods instead of bubbles; a wide churned furrow that slumps; sand heaps over a stuck head; a stronger inhale.

parts.title: Where it comes up
parts.text: Holes no longer open against columns or arcs bow through walls; heroes are edged out of an open hole; the ring comes up at half size out of the hole's dark; the lunge won't aim into a column; the reared head minds the walls.

parts.title: Death and the Book
parts.text: Each ring drops as itself and sinks; the room holds 1.3 s after any boss falls so it's seen. Its Book page has a face, sand and a preview that shows the rear-up.

parts.title: How hard
parts.text: It had drifted easy (67% won at its level); now 53-58%, inside its 40-60% band. Its blows are 40% harder because heroes now waste nothing on the sand.

cards.title: Frozen mid-air
cards.text: Frozen mid-arc, the wurm hangs in the air until it thaws. Leave it?
cards.why: It's the game's rule for anything frozen while airborne; changing it would change it for every leaper.

cards.title: A beat after a boss falls
cards.text: Every boss's room now holds 1.3 s after it dies, so the death is seen before the summary. Keep?
cards.why: The summary used to cut the wurm's death off after 0.6 s; this applies to all bosses.
